recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered collage featuring a central rectangular portrait of a man in an orange long-sleeve shirt sitting on a dark sofa, framed by jagged, torn-paper edges of dark green banana leaves and white negative space, accented by small tropical birds.
coreVisualRelationships: The central portrait is nested within a larger, irregularly framed white field.
Torn-edge banana leaves overlap the top and left margins, creating a sense of depth.
The bright orange of the subject's shirt acts as the primary focal point against dark furniture.
Hand-written text follows the diagonal contour of the upper-right torn edge.
coreInvariants: Jagged, torn-paper texture on all internal borders
High-contrast white background for the upper half
Presence of tropical flora (banana leaves) and fauna (parrots)
Warm, saturated color palette in the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The male subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated orange shirt provides the strongest visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left banana leaf, follows the torn edge down to the subject, and exits through the text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat white in the upper left provide breathing room for the collage elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Forest Green and Black (Leaves and Furniture)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central subject contrasted against the desaturated, high-value white background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Informal, slanted script with varying stroke widths
letterConstructionRules: Hand-drawn appearance with rough, textured edges
Uneven baseline following a diagonal path

composition.relationshipToImage: Follows the edge of the torn leaf

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style hand-lettering to maintain an organic, personal feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, artistic vibe of the original lettering.
Captures the textured, slightly uneven stroke weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage with a central rectangular photo of a man in an orange shirt on a black sofa. Surround this photo with a white field that has jagged, torn-paper edges. Overlap the top and left edges with large, dark green banana leaves that also have torn, white-bordered edges. Place small colorful parrots on the sofa back.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-written, slanted cream-colored text in the upper right corner, following the diagonal line of the torn leaf edge. Use a textured brush style.

verificationChecks: Does the central photo have a clear rectangular boundary within the collage?
Are the edges of the leaves and white space visibly 'torn' rather than clean-cut?
Is the orange of the shirt the most vibrant color in the composition?
Is the text slanted and positioned in the upper right?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the torn edges have a slight white 'paper core' fringe.
Check that the orange shirt doesn't bleed into the background.
Verify the text looks hand-applied rather than typeset.
Confirm the banana leaves look like physical cutouts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a saturated central portrait with torn-paper framing and tropical botanical elements, finished with diagonal hand-lettering in a high-contrast corner.
